NgamBanOnDinh.name: Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định
NgamBanOnDinh.effect: After movement <=3m, complete stop, and valid aimed bow/crossbow shot, reduce by up to 15 percentage points ONLY actual hit penalty caused by preceding movement, not below zero; this replaces Lv1 10pp, does not add.
NgamBanOnDinh.requires: Full stop/stable stance and normal aimed shot; standard action and reload constraints remain
does_not_apply: other penalties such as cover, range or wind
NgamBanOnDinh.not_bonus: Not a flat accuracy bonus, auto hit, extra attack or extra action
NgamBanOnDinh.verified_training: T164 foundation 2/3; T165 first failed 2/5 bow and 3/5 crossbow then corrected and passed 4/5 EACH at ~12m after short repositioning
NgamBanOnDinh.verification: Maela T169 separate 8/10 legal hits with bow and 8/10 with Liên Nỏ after unpredictable <=3m steps, full stops and valid reload, following coached technical practice; not guaranteed.
NgamBanOnDinh.nonstacking: Lv2 replaces Lv1 not additive; does not double-apply same penalty with Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ (which addresses distinct switch-only penalty).

PhoiHopKiemNo.name: Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ
PhoiHopKiemNo.valid_transition: Legally completed sword sheathing -> Liên Nỏ Hắc Nha switching and properly loaded/ready for normally timed aimed shot
PhoiHopKiemNo.effect: After legally securing sword and changing to ready/loaded Liên Nỏ, reduce by at most 10 percentage points only actual hit penalty due to this weapon switch on immediate legally timed aimed shot, floor remaining switch penalty at zero. Lv2 REPLACES Lv1 5pp, not additive.
does_not_apply: Free attack or shot out of turn
Damage bonus or reload speed bonus
PhoiHopKiemNo.stacking_guard: Separately Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định Lv2 addresses only actual movement-specific hit penalty up to15pp after <=3m move, full stop and valid aimed shot. Never apply both to a single penalty.
PhoiHopKiemNo.verified_training: T170 Maela's six multibeat loaded/unloaded crossbow sequences: 1 pass loaded, 2 fail premature trigger on unloaded (no shot), 3 pass loaded, 4 pass properly reloaded, 5 pass loaded, 6 pass properly reloaded; 5/6 meets >=5/6 threshold.

No leader/faction proof. T267: archer shifted along existing north ledge to northwest tarp opening; V got one clear crossbow bolt shot before foe re-concealed. Ordinary bolt preDEF29−DEF10=19, Lv7 archer HP69→50; V's crossbow now unloaded, steel reserve2. Maela did not fire due obstructed individual lane. Enemy leader affiliation unverified. T268: V stowed unloaded Liên Nỏ, drew Huyết Nha+3 and took legal west-rock sword guard; northern Lv7 bowman HP50 visibly moved under cover uphill along existing rock path, exact current location unknown. Maela held nocked arrow without shot, all resources unchanged. No chief proof. T269: V and Maela advanced with cover along north tip of western boulder without crossing open gravel. Upper Lv7 longbowman HP50 retreated up the existing northern path, still unverified identity/faction/chief. No injuries or shots. T270 V exposed himself crossing first patch of loose gravel toward NW outside corner of first crate, archer from existing elevated north bend shot raw30-DEF22=8 actual, V145→137. Maela one valid oblique shot raw27-DEF10=17 actual, enemy archer HP50→33 and retreated into rock cover. No Huyết Ảnh Bộ, no full reaching ascending path, no leader identity. Lv7 archer HP33 moved farther up northern rocks, no clean shot; no leader/faction proof. T272: V reaches existing northern ascent FOOT from gap between first two crates. Lv7 archer HP33 released one bow arrow from higher bend; player ducked behind existing rock, arrow hit stone, no HP loss. Maela held already-nocked bow due blocked lane. No melee, dash, parry, loot, or verified leader proof. T273: V chased north along existing switchback, closed to visible ~3m solid landing after real uphill approach, spent15 STA on Huyết Ảnh Bộ (24→9), landed ONE normal Huyết Nha slash raw34-DEF10=24 on Lv7 archer HP33→9. Hấp Huyết heals2 player137→139; archer dropped longbow, kneeled pleading for mercy at swordpoint, alive and no boss identity proof. T274–T283: Lv7 archer Kerran kept alive (9/85), bound and first-aided; claims Ba Vạch connection unverified. Two documents with similar three-stroke marks, old wagoner and Kerran statements about curved metal left shoulder/two metal clanks, higher north stone route are leads ONLY. Garrick reviewed but NOT verified chief or paid bounty. Kerran at guard station in temporary watch, formal custody unresolved; Maela resting; player at Durgan forge. T284–T292: Durgan reinforced Wolf King armor (DEF24; paid45 Souls) and took spare greatsword balance work paid18. V and Maela redeployed, followed man with curved pale metal near LEFT SHOULDER to newly observed upper north cargo stop bearing three strokes. Heard two metal clanks and one response, saw man meet gray shirt spearman. Gray guard killed T292 while physically grappled, corpse unlooted, no Souls. Cloaked target alerted, armed, HP/leader identity UNKNOWN. Western leader bounty ACTIVE UNPAID. Following upper road discovered marked north timber/stone gate with at least 2 voices. Inside guard closed and barred gate, sounded alarm; no proven chief/quest bounty. T303 first loot outer T302 Lv6 Normal guard +14 Souls to85, four copper to38, physical short sword (later broken), 3-stroke badge and usable leather belt. T304–T306 instrument/real lower-station paperwork produced suspicious partial communication and gave exactly ONE unsigned slip into defenders' custody, not admission.
